description: This file defines the EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity class, which implements the ITableEntity interface for Azure Table Storage. It manages checkpoint data for Event Hub partitions, including creation of partition and row keys, and holds properties like Offset, Timestamp, and ETag.

classes.name: EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity
classes.description: Represents a checkpoint entity for an Event Hub partition, used for tracking stream position in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new instance of EventHubPartitionCheckpointEntity with specified stream provider name, service ID, and partition.

methods.name: MakePartitionKey
methods.description: Generates a sanitized partition key string based on stream provider name and checkpoint namespace.

methods.name: MakeRowKey
methods.description: Generates a sanitized row key string based on the partition identifier.
